content: कक्षः .²1 lurking or hiding place; कोष्टा वराहं निरतक्त कक्षात् <ls>Rv. 10. 28. 4</ls>. .²2 The end of the lower garment; see कक्षा. .²3 A climbing plant, creeper. .²4 Grass, dry grass; यतस्तु कक्षस्तत एव वह्निः <ls>R. 7. 55</ls>, <ls n="R.">11. 75</ls>; यथोद्धरति निर्दाता कक्षं धान्यं च रक्षति <ls>Ms. 7. 110</ls>. .²5 A forest of dead trees, dry wood; <ls>Bṛ. Up. 2. 9. 7</ls>. .²6 The arm-pit; ˚अन्तर <ls>Pt. 1</ls> the cavity of the armpit; प्रक्षिप्योदर्चिषं कक्षे शेरते तेऽभिमारुतम् <ls>Śi. 2. 42</ls>. .²7 The harem of a king. .²8 The interior of a forest; आशु निर्गत्य कक्षात् <ls>Ṛs. 1. 27</ls>; कक्षान्तरगतो वायुः <ls>Rām.</ls> .²9 The side of flank (of anything); ते सरांसि सरित्कक्षान् <ls>Rām. 4. 47. 2</ls>. .²10 A womanʼs girdle; as in आबद्धनिबिडकक्षैः. .²11 A surrounding wall. .²12 A part of a boat. .²13 The orbit of a planet. .²14 A buffalo. .²15 A gate; उपेत्य स यदुश्रेष्टो बाह्यकक्षाद्विनिर्गतः <ls>Mb. 2. 2. 12</ls>. .²16 The Beleric Myrobalan or Terminalia Belerica (<lang>Mar.</lang> <ns>गुग्गुळ, बेहडा</ns>). .²17 A marshy ground. .{@-क्षा@} .²1 Painful boils in the arm-pit. .²2 An elephantʼs rope; also his girth. .²3 A womanʼs girdle or zone; a girdle, waist-band (in general); ‘कक्षा बृहतिकायां स्यात्काञ्च्यां मध्येभबन्धने’ इति विश्वः; युधे परैः सह दृढबद्धकक्षया <ls>Śi. 17. 24</ls>. .²4 A surrounding wall; a wall, .²5 The waist, middle part; एते हि विद्युद्गुणबद्धकक्षा <ls>Mk. 5. 21</ls>. .²6 A courtyard; area, <ls>Rām. 4. 33. 19</ls> (सप्तकक्षा); त्रीणि गुल्मान्यतीयाय तिस्रः कक्षाश्च स द्विजः <ls>Bhāg. 10. 80. 16</ls>. .²7 An enclosure. .²8 An inner apartment, a private chamber; room in general; ‘कक्षा कच्छे वस्त्रायां काञ्च्यां गेहे प्रकोष्ठके’ इति यादवः; <ls>Ku. 7. 70</ls>; <ls>Ms. 7. 224</ls>; गृहकलहंसकाननुसरन् कक्षान्तरप्रधावितः <ls>K. 63</ls>, <ls n="K.">182</ls>; कक्षासु रक्षितैर्दक्षैस्तार्क्ष्यः सर्पेष्विवापतत् <ls>Parṇāl. 3. 38</ls>. .²9 A harem. .²10 Similarity. .²11 An upper garment; दुर्योधनो हस्तिनं पद्मवर्णं सुवर्णकक्षम् <ls>Mb. 6. 20. 7</ls>. .²12 Objection or reply in argument (in Logic <ab>&c.</ab>). .²13 Emulation or rivalry. .²14 A secluded part of an edifice; गत्वा कक्षान्तरं त्वन्यत् <ls>Ms. 7. 224</ls>. .²15 A particular part of a carriage. .²16 The jewellerʼs weight, {%Rati%}. .²17 The end of the lower garment which, after the cloth is girt round the lower part of the body, is brought up behind and tucked into the waist-band (<lang>Mar.</lang> <ns>कांसोटा</ns>) .²18 Tying up the waist. .²19 The wrist. .²20 Border or lace; स्वर्णकक्षपताकाभिः <ls>Bhāg. 9. 10. 37</ls>. .²21 The basin of a balance (कक्षः also). .{@-क्षम्@} .²1 A star. .²2 Sin. .{@-(क्षा)पटः@} a cloth passed between the legs to cover the privities.
